canonical: The docs own the meaning of every rule. This file encodes the arithmetic and cites the doc section for each rule. Where it and a doc disagree, the doc wins and this file is a bug.

conventions.currency: One reporting currency and one scale (thousands or millions) per evaluation, recorded with it (docs/data-quality.md#fundamentals).
conventions.positive_outflow: A cash outflow given as a positive number. A vendor that reports outflows as negative numbers is flipped before use (outflow_sign_convention: negative).
conventions.signed: Positive is a cash inflow, negative a cash outflow.
conventions.fraction: A share as a decimal: 0.25 is 25%.
conventions.fraction_of_portfolio: A share of the whole portfolio as a decimal (docs/pipeline.md#sizing-by-loss-budget).
conventions.not_applicable: The string "not_applicable": the measure does not exist for these inputs. Never recorded as 0.
conventions.not_applied: The string "not_applied": the rule is not applied in this sleeve or account.
conventions.unlimited: The string "unlimited": runway when annual outflow is 0.
conventions.ambiguous: A rule or part of a rule with ambiguous: true is one where the doc does not settle the answer. The reference implementation returns "ambiguous" or "ambiguous_boundary" there instead of choosing.

vector_cases.pass: Ordinary inputs on which the rule's test is not triggered (no fire, no flag, no rebalance, no wash sale), or an ordinary computation.
vector_cases.fail: Inputs on which the test is triggered.
vector_cases.boundary: Inputs at or next to a threshold, showing which side the threshold itself falls on.
vector_cases.edge: A case the docs call out by name (sign flips, not applicable, double counting, and the like).

thresholds.comparison: flag when top-customer share > value or any backlog share > value
anchor customer when backlog share (or revenue-share fallback) at the last filing before the event > value
a cut in contract value counts when > value
lower edge of the band read more closely (exclusive)
upper edge of the band read more closely (exclusive); fixed by the doc, independent of the implementation's cutoff
speculative target size <= value * sleeve weight
at entry, bought only when size >= value * sleeve weight
fixed value in the speculative sleeve
window is sale date - value through sale date + value, inclusive (61 days)
a candidate with days < value is excluded, never annualized

rules.name: Trailing twelve months from year-to-date figures

inputs.name: fiscal_years
inputs.note: Chronological list of fiscal years, each with ytd_3m, ytd_6m, ytd_9m, ytd_12m year-to-date values. The latest year may stop early.

formula: quarter_1 = ytd_3m
quarter_k = ytd_(3k)m - ytd_(3k-3)m for k = 2, 3
quarter_4 = ytd_12m - ytd_9m   (full year minus nine-month year to date)
ttm = sum of the last four discrete quarters
notes: Fewer than four quarters is an error: a single quarter is never multiplied by four.
Every fiscal year except the latest must have all four year-to-date values, so a missing fourth quarter is an error, never skipped.
A year whose year-to-date values have a gap (for example ytd_9m without ytd_6m) is an error.

rules.name: Free cash flow, cash burn and funding dependence

inputs.name: operating_cash_flow
inputs.note: TTM.

inputs.name: stock_based_compensation
inputs.note: TTM.

inputs.name: capital_expenditure
inputs.note: TTM.

inputs.name: finance_lease_principal_paid
inputs.note: TTM. Zero for an IFRS filer after normalization.

inputs.name: stock_issued
inputs.note: TTM cash proceeds.

inputs.name: stock_repurchased
inputs.note: TTM.

inputs.name: net_new_debt
inputs.note: TTM, including convertibles; borrowing less repayment.

inputs.name: outflow_sign_convention
inputs.note: positive (default) or negative: how the vendor reports capital expenditure, finance-lease principal and stock repurchased.

inputs.name: basis
inputs.note: US_GAAP (default) or IFRS.

inputs.name: ifrs_lease_principal_paid
inputs.note: IFRS only: lease principal shown in financing, moved into operating cash flow.

inputs.name: ifrs_interest_paid_in_financing
inputs.note: IFRS only: interest paid shown in financing, moved into operating cash flow.

formula: IFRS: operating_cash_flow -= ifrs_lease_principal_paid + ifrs_interest_paid_in_financing; finance_lease_principal_paid must be 0
free_cash_flow = operating_cash_flow - stock_based_compensation - capital_expenditure - finance_lease_principal_paid
cash_burn = max(0, -free_cash_flow)
net_stock_issued = stock_issued - stock_repurchased
external_funding = net_stock_issued + net_new_debt
funding_dependence = external_funding / cash_burn, or not_applicable when cash_burn = 0 or external_funding <= 0

rules.name: Dependent

inputs.name: sleeve
inputs.note: speculative, or any other sleeve name.

formula: fires = free_cash_flow < 0 and funding_dependence != not_applicable and funding_dependence > funding_dependence_max
rules.applies_to: Every sleeve except the speculative sleeve (not_applied there). Checked at each quarterly filing.
notes: free_cash_flow is net of stock-based compensation, so unlike SR-1b this test can be met by a business whose only shortfall is stock-based compensation, if it also raises more than that amount. The docs state the stock-based-compensation guard for SR-1b only.

rules.name: Liquidity runway in quarters

inputs.name: outflow_sign_convention
inputs.note: positive (default) or negative, as in signal.funding_dependence. Applies to every positive_outflow input below; liquidity and operating_cash_flow_ttm are not flipped.

inputs.name: cash_and_cash_equivalents
inputs.note: Excluding restricted cash.

inputs.name: restricted_cash
inputs.note: Recorded, never added to liquidity.

inputs.name: short_term_investments
inputs.note: Marketable securities reported as current, excluding pledged or restricted ones.

inputs.name: pledged_or_restricted_investments
inputs.note: Recorded, never added to liquidity.

inputs.name: facilities
inputs.note: List of {kind, undrawn, committed, conditions_met}. Counted only when kind is credit_line, committed is true and conditions_met is true. An uncommitted line, an at-the-market equity program (kind atm_equity_program) or a line with an unmet condition is not counted.

inputs.name: operating_cash_flow_ttm
inputs.note: After the IFRS normalization in signal.funding_dependence. Stock-based compensation is not deducted.

inputs.name: interest_paid_in_ocf
inputs.note: Interest paid inside operating cash flow, including the interest part of finance-lease payments.

inputs.name: operating_lease_payments_in_ocf
inputs.note: Operating-lease payments inside operating cash flow.

inputs.name: capital_expenditure_planned_next_12m
inputs.note: The company's stated plan; null when it states none.

inputs.name: capital_expenditure_ttm
inputs.note: Used when no plan is stated.

inputs.name: scheduled_debt_service_next_12m
inputs.note: Interest and principal due in the next twelve months from the debt maturity note, excluding lease liabilities.

inputs.name: lease_payments_next_12m
inputs.note: All lease payments due in the next twelve months, operating and finance.

formula: liquidity = cash_and_cash_equivalents + short_term_investments + sum(counted facilities.undrawn)
operating_cash_burn = max(0, -(operating_cash_flow_ttm + interest_paid_in_ocf + operating_lease_payments_in_ocf))
capital_expenditure_used = capital_expenditure_planned_next_12m if stated else capital_expenditure_ttm
annual_outflow = operating_cash_burn + capital_expenditure_used + scheduled_debt_service_next_12m + lease_payments_next_12m
runway_quarters = 4 * liquidity / annual_outflow, or unlimited when annual_outflow = 0

ambiguities.note: IFRS filers. The normalization moves lease principal into operating cash flow, but the operating-cash-burn add-back names only interest and operating-lease payments. For an IFRS filer it is not stated whether the moved lease principal is added back; if it is not, leases are counted in burn and again in lease_payments_next_12m. The vectors cover US GAAP filers only.

rules.name: Unfunded burn

inputs.name: sleeve
inputs.note: speculative, or any other sleeve name.

formula: burns_cash = operating_cash_burn + capital_expenditure_ttm > 0
fires = burns_cash and runway_quarters != unlimited and runway_quarters < runway_min_quarters
rules.applies_to: Every sleeve except the speculative sleeve (not_applied there), whatever the funding dependence, including not_applicable. Checked at each quarterly filing.
notes: The gate uses TTM capital expenditure, while annual_outflow uses the stated plan when there is one. Both are as the doc states.

rules.name: Distress language

inputs.name: going_concern
inputs.note: A going-concern paragraph.

formula: fires = going_concern or covenant_breach or lender_waiver_or_forbearance

rules.name: Liquidity runway
formula: fires = runway_quarters != unlimited and runway_quarters < runway_min_quarters  (no burn gate)
rules.applies_to: Capital-intensive builders, in every sleeve; not_applicable otherwise.

rules.name: Anchor customer lost

inputs.name: event
inputs.note: termination, default, contract_value_cut or none.

inputs.name: contract_value_cut_fraction
inputs.note: Required when event is contract_value_cut. Computed by the adopter; see ambiguities.

inputs.name: backlog_share_at_last_filing
inputs.note: The customer's share of backlog at the last filing before the event; null when not disclosed.

inputs.name: revenue_share_at_last_filing
inputs.note: Fallback when backlog share is not disclosed; the result is then marked unverified.

formula: share_used = backlog_share_at_last_filing, else revenue_share_at_last_filing (share_unverified = true)
anchor_customer = share_used > k3_backlog_share_min
fires = anchor_customer and (event in {termination, default} or (event = contract_value_cut and contract_value_cut_fraction > k3_contract_cut_min))

ambiguities.note: "A cut of more than 25% in contract value" does not say what the cut is measured against (the contract value before the cut, at the last filing, or an annual run rate) or whether it is total or annual value. The spec takes the cut fraction as an input instead of choosing.

rules.name: Customer concentration flag

inputs.name: total_backlog
inputs.note: Null when not disclosed.

inputs.name: customers
inputs.note: List of {revenue, backlog}; backlog null when not disclosed by customer.

formula: top_customer_share = max(customer.revenue) / total_revenue
backlog share per customer = customer.backlog / total_backlog, else customer.revenue / total_revenue (backlog_share_unverified = true)
flagged = top_customer_share > concentration_max_share or max_backlog_share > concentration_max_share

rules.name: Beneish M-Score screen

inputs.name: m_score
inputs.note: Computed by the implementation with coefficients and input definitions it records; the docs do not fix them.

inputs.name: cutoff
inputs.note: The implementation's cutoff. Beneish, Lee and Nichols (2013) use -1.78.

inputs.name: cutoff_source
inputs.note: Required: the source of the cutoff.

formula: in_band = mscore_read_closely_lower < m_score < mscore_read_closely_upper
status = ambiguous_boundary when m_score equals the cutoff or either band edge
status = ambiguous_overlap when m_score > cutoff and in_band (only possible when the cutoff is below -1.78)
status = flag when m_score > cutoff and not in_band
status = read_closely when in_band and m_score < cutoff
status = none otherwise (below the band, or between the band and a cutoff above -1.78)
rules.applies_to: Score-based: checked at each annual filing.

ambiguities.note: The docs do not fix the coefficients, the model form or the cutoff; they require the implementation to record them, citing -1.78 as the 2013 paper's cutoff.
Whether a score exactly at the cutoff is a flag, and whether the band "between -2.22 and -1.78" includes its edges, is not stated.

The band is fixed at -2.22 to -1.78, but the cutoff is the implementation's. When the cutoff lies inside or below the band, a score above the cutoff and inside the band is both a flag and a score to read closely; the doc does not say which applies. The reference implementation returns ambiguous_overlap there.

rules.name: Auditor change, non-reliance or restatement
formula: fires = auditor_change_item_4_01 or non_reliance_item_4_02 or restatement; checked on receipt

rules.name: Earnings ahead of cash

inputs.name: years
inputs.note: Chronological list of fiscal years with net_income, net_income_continuing_ops, operating_cash_flow and total_assets (nonnegative).

formula: total_accruals_to_total_assets = (net_income_continuing_ops - operating_cash_flow) / total_assets, per year
net_income_above_ocf = net_income > operating_cash_flow in each of the latest two years
flag = net_income_above_ocf or tata_rising
rules.applies_to: Score-based: checked at each annual filing, so the latest years are used.

ambiguities.note: "Total accruals to total assets rising in two consecutive years" can mean two consecutive increases (three years of data) or an increase from one year to the next (two years). The reference implementation returns tata_rising = "ambiguous" when the two readings disagree.

rules.name: Longer asset lives

inputs.name: carrying_amount
inputs.note: At the change date.

formula: depreciable_base = carrying_amount - residual_value
depreciation_old_basis = depreciable_base / old_remaining_life
depreciation_new_basis = depreciable_base / new_remaining_life
extra_pretax_profit = depreciation_old_basis - depreciation_new_basis
flag = new_remaining_life > old_remaining_life

rules.name: Collar plus income: pricing one candidate

inputs.name: call_bid
inputs.note: Missing, zero or negative means cannot price.

inputs.name: put_ask
inputs.note: Missing, zero or negative means cannot price, never free.

inputs.name: days_to_expiration
inputs.note: From the pricing date to the expiration date.

formula: net_credit = call_bid - put_ask
status = cannot_price when either quote is missing, zero or negative; excluded when days_to_expiration < collar_min_days_to_expiration; else priced
annualized_net = (net_credit / spot) * 365 / days_to_expiration, only when priced
notes: The vectors check net_credit and status only. They stop before any yield figure (COMPLIANCE.md, guardrail 3).

rules.name: Collar plus income: ranking candidates

inputs.name: candidates
inputs.note: List of collar.price inputs, each with an id.

formula: order = priced candidate ids sorted by annualized_net, highest first; excluded = ids that cannot be priced or are excluded

rules.name: Sizing by loss budget, with caps and entry floor

inputs.name: bucket
inputs.note: {budget, used}: the factor bucket's loss budget and the stressed loss already used.

inputs.name: nodes
inputs.note: Map of node name to {budget, used}.

inputs.name: stressed_loss_per_dollar
inputs.note: Fixed at 1.0 in the speculative sleeve.

inputs.name: is_entry
inputs.note: Default true. The floor applies at entry only.

formula: remaining = budget - used, for the bucket and each node
budget_size = max(0, min(remaining bucket, min over nodes of remaining node) / stressed_loss_per_dollar)
sleeve_limit = size_ceiling_share_of_sleeve (speculative: speculative_ceiling_share_of_sleeve) * sleeve_weight
size = min(budget_size, tier_ceiling, sleeve_limit)
binding = every constraint equal to size: bucket, node:<name>, tier, sleeve_limit
at entry: status = not_bought and size = 0 when size < entry_floor_share_of_sleeve * sleeve_weight
notes: When two constraints tie, all are recorded; the doc asks for the binding constraint and does not say how to break a tie.

rules.name: Drift band

inputs.name: account_type
inputs.note: retirement or taxable.

formula: lower = target_weight * (1 - drift_band_relative); upper = target_weight * (1 + drift_band_relative)
rebalance = weight < lower or weight > upper (the edges are inside the band); not_applied in taxable accounts

rules.name: Wash-sale window across accounts

inputs.name: acquisitions
inputs.note: List of {id, date, owner (self or spouse), account (taxable or retirement), kind (purchase, dividend_reinvestment, bought_call, sold_put_deep_itm), substantially_identical (boolean, the adopter's judgment)}.

formula: window = [sale_date - wash_sale_days_each_side, sale_date + wash_sale_days_each_side], calendar days, inclusive (61 days)
triggering = acquisitions inside the window, substantially identical, owner self or spouse, any account, kind purchase, dividend_reinvestment or bought_call
needs_review = such acquisitions of kind sold_put_deep_itm
wash_sale = triggering is not empty; not_applicable when the sale is not at a loss
notes: Retirement accounts of every kind count. Revenue Ruling 2008-5 covers purchases in an IRA or Roth IRA only; treating every retirement plan the same way goes beyond the ruling and is this method's choice, as portfolio-process.md says.
An acquisition of unknown kind is an error, whatever its date or owner.

ambiguities.note: A sold put deep in the money "can also count": the doc does not say when. The reference implementation lists it under needs_review instead of deciding.
Acquirers other than the investor and a spouse (for example a dependent, a trust or an entity the investor controls) are not addressed; the reference implementation raises an error for them.

not_encoded.what: Holding period (more than one year) and the collar tax checks (sections 1092, 1233(b), 1259)
not_encoded.why: The docs state the conditions but not a day-count convention, and several checks need a written judgment.
The tolerance is given as an example, not a setting, and selection needs an option chain.
They are templates; each becomes computable only once written for a name.

not_encoded.what: Data-quality checks (for example the 3% source-disagreement rule)
not_encoded.why: They act on data pulls, not on the rule inputs; out of scope for this version of the spec.
